metadata.description: Real-time road traffic incidents in Japan. Aggregated from Yahoo!道路交通情報, Yahoo!トランジット, NHK RSS (cat7), and MLIT. traffic_multiplier reflects incident impact on local risk model.
metadata.notes: JARTIC (jartic.or.jp) was replaced with Yahoo!道路交通情報 (road.yahoo.co.jp) due to 404 errors on the JARTIC public page. NHK RSS cat7 covers society/traffic news (事故/渋滞/通行止め); secondary filters: ROAD_KEYWORDS (road incidents) OR railway_keywords (脱線/衝突/踏切/鉄道/列車/電車/新幹線) — sports/industrial false positives removed. iter4: truncated RSS descriptions (ending '...' or '…') trigger article fetch from NHK article URL to recover location text cut off by RSS truncation. Boilerplate blocks (nav chrome, empty-state messages <15 chars) are filtered. geocode_method priority: railway_centroid > highway_name > route_centroid > pref_centroid > city_centroid > none. railway_centroid: matched RAILWAY_COORDS dict (60+ JR/private/shinkansen lines). highway_name: matched HIGHWAY_COORDS dict (60+ expressways). route_centroid: 国道X号 mapped via ROUTE_COORDS. pref_centroid: prefecture name matched in text. city_centroid: city→prefecture centroid fallback.
